description: Owner decision 2026-08-18: the 2026.1 demo venue is local Docker first. This target reuses the repository's existing Phase-A seam compose file so the server image is injected from platform-manifest.yaml and the driver can never run against a floating tag.

compose.notes: This compose file composes PostGIS + Honua Server only. Redis is absent, so the durable proposal/approval control plane has no backing store here; that bound is tracked by honua-release#202 and honua-server#3583 and is recorded as a receipt notice, never as a pass.

adminPassword.notes: Installer-provisioned bootstrap credential from the compose file. Never emitted into a receipt.
